Flèches : glisser · Retour arrière : ann: Arrows: slide · Backspace: undo · R: restart · H: hint · P: pause
Glace, un casse-tête en pixel art : sur: Glace, a pixel-art puzzle: on the ice, the penguin slides to the next rock. Find the way to the flag in as few moves as possible. 80 levels all checked solvable, snow that stops you dead, then cracked ice that breaks once you leave it, snow piles to push and teleporters; stars for the shortest path, a hint if you are stuck. Keyboard, mouse or gamepad, full screen.
Pousse-le : il glisse à son tour: Push it: it slides in turn
Sur la glace, le pingouin ne s'arrête pa: On ice, the penguin cannot stop: it slides to the next rock or to the edge. Snow stops it dead. Get it to the flag. Three stars if you find the shortest path, two if you need two more moves. A hint shows the right move, but the level is then worth one star. After level 60: cracked ice breaks once you leave it (the water then stops you), snow piles can be pushed and slide in turn, teleporters send you from one to the other.
